data.problem: Session resumption and tracking are inconsistent across OpenCode, Vercel AI SDK, and Claude Agent SDK; Task tool subagent sessions do not reliably resume because session IDs are not consistently propagated or persisted.
constraints: Explore phase only; no implementation work in this packet.
OpenCode session IDs are local and stored in Storage; provider sessions are separate.
Claude Agent SDK session_id mapping is currently in-memory.
Task tool resume requires session_id input; current linkage is only via tool output metadata.

options.name: Propagate OpenCode sessionId into Claude Agent SDK providerOptions
options.approach: Use OpenCode sessionID (and messageID where available) as providerOptions['claude-agent-sdk'].sessionId so the SDK session store keys per OpenCode session. Verify tool-bridge now receives a valid ses_* sessionID and that SDK resume tokens are isolated per session.
options.what_we_learn: Whether the default 'default' sessionKey is causing session collisions and tool-bridge context loss; whether resume starts working per session.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium (may not fix Task tool resume or cross-process persistence).

options.name: Persist SDK session IDs + Task subagent linkage
options.approach: Store claude-agent-sdk session_id per OpenCode session in Storage; persist parent→child session mapping for Task tool runs. Use stored session_id to resume subagent sessions automatically.
options.what_we_learn: Whether persistence and explicit linkage resolve resume issues across restarts and subagent flows.

options.name: Disable SDK resume and rely on OpenCode history
options.approach: Avoid using claude-agent-sdk resume tokens; always run stateless SDK calls with full OpenCode message history.
options.what_we_learn: Whether resume-related bugs disappear when provider-native sessions are bypassed.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium (loss of SDK-native state/tool memory; potential regressions).

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it is the fastest way to validate the likely root cause (missing sessionId propagation) and should immediately improve session isolation and tool tracking if correct.
